input.free_text_description: This system is a microservices platform that serves User, Admin roles. The platform provides capabilities for my exception handler, dept manager, general manager. Secondary concerns include user management functionality.

user_stories.story: As a User, I want to securely sign in to the system, so that I can access my personalized resources.
As an Admin, I want to manage system configuration and monitor operations, so that I can ensure the platform runs smoothly.
As a User, I want to interact with flow functionality, so that I can accomplish my flow-related tasks.
As a User, I want to interact with leave functionality, so that I can accomplish my leave-related tasks.
As a User, I want to use my exception handler capabilities, so that I can perform essential business operations.
